problems.name: FaceID missing on iPhone Duo

quotes.author: kristianp
quotes.text: Why is there no FaceId? Is the camera too low-res?

problems.summary: Users want FaceID on the iPhone Duo for quick, secure unlocking, but the device lacks the necessary hardware and software support, leaving them with only password or Touch ID alternatives.

problems.name: Free decent email service

quotes.author: encrypted_bird
quotes.text: …thanks I'll check it out! --- EDIT: Ohhhhhh apparently it's paid-only. Yeah, I would pay for a decent email service, but I'm poor, so I can't afford that... Thanks, anyway!

problems.summary: Users need a free email provider that offers privacy, ample storage, and a clean interface, but existing free services are either ad‑driven, limited in features, or compromise security.

problems.name: Process context dump tool

quotes.author: ajasmin
quotes.text: Is there a tool in Windows that will dump all of a process context to debug these kind of things: CWD, env vars, current user, elevation, etc.

problems.summary: Developers need a reliable way to capture a process’s full context for debugging, but current utilities either lack depth, are platform‑specific, or require complex setup.

problems.name: Virtual guitar VST plugin

quotes.author: tuzemec
quotes.text: I would pay for this in a VST form

problems.name: GitHub alternative with Anthropic AI

problems.name: Desktop app for easy website creation

quotes.author: privacyishuman
quotes.text: Why is there no GUI desktop app that lets you easily make a website?

problems.name: Missing diff viewer and Vim mode in Helix

quotes.author: jswelker
quotes.text: …And even though abstractly I like helix's keyboard model better than vim, I wish there was a way to just switch to vim mode because it is too ingrained. Maybe this fork can address some of this either directly or by allowing plugins.

problems.name: Run extension code in current tab

quotes.author: cobbzilla
quotes.text: …want to write a Firefox extension that runs in your open browser tab? I would pay for this.

problems.summary: Users want a simple way to execute extension scripts directly in an open browser tab, but existing methods require separate extensions or devtools, making it cumbersome and unreliable.

problems.name: OLED or LCD version of Boox Go 7

quotes.text: …got the Boox for Android under the hood so that I could scan my email and RSS. I wish there was an OLED or an LCD version of the same device.

problems.summary: Users want a Boox Go 7 with OLED or LCD display, but current models only offer e‑ink, limiting color and brightness options.

problems.name: Mac container orchestration like quadlets

problems.name: DIY poster-size eInk panels for hobbyists

problems.name: Steam client steals focus

quotes.text: Why is there no option to prevent it stealing focus?!?

problems.name: Silence AirTag warning for specific tag

quotes.author: nazgul17
quotes.text: …every morning I get a notification that an unknown tracker is following me. I wish there was a way to silence the warning for that specific tag.

problems.summary: Users want to mute the AirTag sound for a single tag, but Apple only allows global silence or no silence, leaving them unable to target individual tags.
